display.purpose: The intro sentence under the name; the largest text on the page.

headline.purpose: The name, top left. The only text set at medium weight.

subtitle.purpose: The role line under the name, in gray.

body.purpose: Row labels, entry titles, project names, inline detail. The working size for most of the page.

detail.purpose: Longer story paragraphs inside an opened entry, and the About paragraph.

figure.purpose: Labels, axis text and captions inside the line figures.

motion.name: ease-hover
motion.purpose: Default 200ms transition for link underline and color hover states.

motion.name: ease-out-nudge
motion.purpose: 200ms transform on the external-link arrow's hover nudge.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The slow-reveal curve: 500ms entry panel open/close, 900ms figure line-draw.

components.name: Plain-Text Link
components.description: An external link (Projects, Clients): near-white text, transparent underline at rest, gray underline and a nudging arrow on hover.
components.html: Interview Studio
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #ededed; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), text-decoration-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); font-family: 'Albert Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { text-decoration-color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ededed; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-link-arrow { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; stroke: #a3a3a3; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: none; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-link:hover .ds-link-arrow { transform: translate(1px, -1px); }

components.name: Disclosure Entry
components.description: A 'Built' row: a native details/summary trigger with a plus-to-cross icon; opens to a gray story and a hand-drawn line figure.
components.html:
One codebase, three countrieskudy.io, kudy.ng 2024, kudy.us 20252024

Kudy began with one site, kudy.io. I split the codebase so it builds a separate site per country.
components.css: .ds-entry summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-family: 'Albert Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #ededed; } .ds-entry summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-entry-title { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-entry summary:hover .ds-entry-title, .ds-entry[open] .ds-entry-title { text-decoration-color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-entry-sub { display: block; color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-entry-icon { width: 10px; height: 10px; stroke: #a3a3a3; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linecap: round; fill: none; transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-entry[open] .ds-entry-icon { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-entry-panel { max-width: 34rem; padding: 12px 0 20px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-entry::details-content { block-size: 0; overflow: visible clip; transition: block-size 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), content-visibility 0.5s allow-discrete; } .ds-entry[open]::details-content { block-size: auto; }

components.name: Round Avatar
components.description: The 80px circular photo at the top right of the page.
components.css: .ds-avatar { width: 80px; height: 80px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; object-fit: cover; }

components.name: Signature Line Figure
components.description: The hand-drawn SVG inside an opened 'Built' entry. Shared vocabulary: a near-white drawn line, gray dots and captions, hairline reference strokes. The main path animates in on open.
components.css: .ds-figure svg { width: 100%; max-width: 20rem; overflow: visible; fill: #ededed; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Albert Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-figure circle { fill: #ededed; } .ds-figure .ds-mute { fill: #a3a3a3; } .ds-draw { stroke: #ededed; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-entry[open] .ds-draw { stroke-dasharray: 1; animation: ds-draw 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

components.name: Label Row
components.description: The recurring two-column grid: a fixed gray label ('Now', 'Built'...) beside fluid content. Every section on the page reuses this one row.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr; column-gap: 12px; } .ds-row h2 { color: #a3a3a3; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-weight: 400; margin: 0; } .ds-row p { color: #ededed; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
This is one page, read like a short, well-kept record: a name, one sentence, then rows of plain fact. Nothing on the page asks for attention on its own. A visitor's eye moves down a narrow column of gray labels (Now, Built, Projects, Elsewhere) into wider columns of near-white text, and the only color in the whole system is the gap between "bright" and "dim." There is no accent hue, no card, no shadow, no icon set beyond a hairline arrow and a plus sign. The one flourish the page allows itself is a small hand-drawn line figure that appears when a "Built" row opens, sketching the fact just told (three sites from one codebase, one library feeding two apps, a chart of the move to TypeScript).

The page is dark by product commitment, not by mood: it is dark because that is the only theme this site has. Within that constraint the register is restrained and factual, closer to a well-set terminal or a lab notebook than a marketing page. It rejects the hero-plus-cards portfolio shape on purpose: no boxed project tiles, no big display headline, no testimonial strip.
keyCharacteristics: One page, one column, no boxes.
Three text colors and nothing else: near-white for what matters, gray for what supports it, and the near-black ground.
Structure comes from a fixed label column and vertical space, never from a border or a shadow.
The only shape besides straight lines is a circle (the photo, and the dots in each figure).
Motion has two speeds: a quick 200ms nudge for hover, and a slow, confident reveal (500-900ms) for anything that opens or draws itself in.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no primary or secondary accent color. Every visual distinction on the page is a value shift between these four grays, never a hue. If a new element seems to need color to stand out, that is a sign it should compete on size, weight, or position instead.

rules.name: The Selection-Is-Inverted Rule
rules.body: Text selection (::selection) swaps the two ends of the palette: near-white background, near-black text. It is the one moment the system runs its contrast in reverse, and it is confirmed, exact, and load-bearing (not a browser default left in place).

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Every character on the page, from the name to a figure's axis label, is Albert Sans. There is no serif, no mono, no second family for numbers or code.

rules.name: The One-Grid Rule
rules.body: Every row on the page uses the same two-column label grid. A new section should reuse it rather than invent a different column split.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts off the page. If a new component seems to need a shadow to separate it from its surroundings, add space or a label instead.

rules.name: The Circle-Only Rule
rules.body: The photo and the dots inside a line figure are the only curves on the page. A new element that wants a rounded corner should default to sharp instead, unless it is genuinely circular.

dos: Do keep every new visual difference to a shift in the four established values (near-black, near-white, quiet-gray, hairline), never a new hue.
Do reuse the one two-column label grid for any new row; don't invent a second layout pattern for a new section.
Do keep hover feedback fast (200ms) and reveal/open motion slow (500-900ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); don't blend the two speeds.

Do set every new figure in the same line-dot-text vocabulary (.draw, .mute, .grid) and label only the points that matter, with always-visible text so a new figure reads as part of the same family as the other figures.
donts: Don't add a card, a box, a border, a divider line, or a drop shadow. Structure comes from the label column and space only.
Don't introduce a second font family, a display-size headline, or a weight above 500.
Don't add an accent color, a gradient, or a themed/costume visual world. The brief calls for the category-standard engineer portfolio played straight, not a themed variant.
Don't add a light theme or a theme toggle; this system is dark-only by product commitment.
Don't round a corner just for softness. Sharp is the default; circular is reserved for things that are actually round (the photo, a point in a figure).
